args.query: httpx 0.28 removed the app= argument: test a FastAPI ASGI app with AsyncClient and ASGITransport

results.title: FastAPI lifespan state tested with httpx ASGITransport and asgi-lifespan
results.summary: A FastAPI app that opens a SQLite connection in its lifespan, then test it offline through httpx ASGITransport, with asgi-lifespan running startup and shutdown.

results.title: FastAPI dependency_overrides tested offline with httpx ASGITransport
results.summary: Override FastAPI dependencies (including nested ones) and drive the app in-process with httpx.ASGITransport, no network and no running server.

results.title: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy 2 on aiosqlite, tested offline with per-test in-memory DBs
results.summary: A FastAPI app using AsyncSession and async_sessionmaker on aiosqlite, tested with httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport, overriding the session dependency with a fresh in-memory database for each test.

results.title: Starlette routes and middleware tested offline with httpx ASGITransport
results.summary: A Starlette app with BaseHTTPMiddleware and lifespan state, exercised in-process via httpx ASGITransport without a real server.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints cached with cashews in-memory backend
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by a cashews mem:// cache with key templates, TTL and explicit invalidation, tested fully offline through httpx ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI metrics with prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator tested offline
results.summary: Instrument a FastAPI app with the default prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator metrics, scrape /metrics through httpx.ASGITransport, and cover the route-template labels, untemplated grouping, self-scraping and shared-registry gotchas.

results.title: FastAPI metrics with prometheus_client scraped as text
results.summary: Instrument FastAPI with prometheus_client using a per-app registry, label by route template to bound cardinality, and scrape the text exposition format offline through httpx.ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI routes wired to a dependency-injector DeclarativeContainer, tested offline
results.summary: Build a DeclarativeContainer with Configuration, Singleton and Factory providers, wire it into FastAPI routes with @inject and Depends(Provide[...]), and test it in-process with httpx.ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI config via pydantic-settings as a cached dependency
results.summary: Load config from env vars with pydantic-settings, inject it into FastAPI routes through a cached dependency, and test it offline with monkeypatch and dependency_overrides.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints rate limited with slowapi, tested with TestClient
results.summary: Add per-route and per-API-key rate limits to FastAPI with slowapi, then test 429 behavior offline with TestClient and the in-memory store.
